rows.Bloom: Red, purple shading, light yellow reverse. Medium, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Well-branched. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 4'11" (150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Parentage:
Queen Elizabeth (Hybrid Tea, Lammerts before 1951) ×
Baronne Edmond de Rothschild ®

colour: Red, purple shading, light yellow reverse.
